hooks.text: 在可破坏的小行星环境中用2D物理采矿，块状像素画面把碰撞、射击与爆炸做成直接反馈
hooks.excerpt: Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics and a destructible environment. Set in the distant future where mining ship pilots work for exploitative corporations; you will have to upgrade your ship, master the asteroids, and make difficult decisions if you want to survive and secure your future. 2D Physics + Pixel Art: Chunky pixel art and physics provide satisfying crashes, shots, and explosions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 针对每次采矿任务升级飞船并选择最合适的工具，但所有装备选择都有明确代价
hooks.excerpt: Choose Your Equipment: Upgrade your ship and choose the best tools for the job, but remember; everything has a price.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 身处剥削型企业体系，玩家可选择遵守公司法律求生，或亲手夺回自己的未来来改变故事
hooks.excerpt: Survive Bureaucracy: Choose how your story unfolds; stick to corporate law to survive, or take your future into your own hands.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
